feature.label: RISC OS sources
feature.description: Working on RISC OS source trees: an import wizard that makes projects from a built tree's components and configurations; for ARM assembler (objasm), indexing across the tree, with go to definition, find uses, hover, completion, outline, folding and shading of code a configuration doesn't assemble; for BBC BASIC, text or tokenised, colouring, routines and variables, problems, outline and completion of routines and SWI names; colouring of CMHG files, and Messages files with NULs edited safely.
